"Who knew a valentines day party would be such a great place to meet new friends!Seems as though these two hot boys are getting to know each other very well~Super excited to finally share some Ben on Ben action with you guys!Hope you guys love this piece as much as I loved makin it~Happy Valentines, everyone!" - Page 1 & 6

"After meeting at a valentines day party a few weeks prior Sandra, Ben, Benneq, and Ashe decided they wanted a more private party of their own. Being ever eager Sandra and Ashe realized they should teach their husbands some manners before diving in. Will they learn to be good boys? It seems they wont have much of a choice!This is going to be a multi-part series featuring Aycee's adorable couple characters: Ben (Orange Character, [He/Him]) and Sandra (Under Ashe, [She/Her]) having some fun with Benneq and Ashe! Aycee and I have been having such an awesome time working on these for you all, so we sincerely hope you love em just as much as we do!" - Page 2 & 7

"Turning up the heat! Sandra and Ashe didn't plan on having all the fun, though they both clearly have their own agenda for the boys. Gags are fun and all but they have a nasty habit of muffling those cute moans." - Page 3 & 8

'"Well done you two!""Good boys deserve a treat, don't they~"Sandra and Ashe decide to give their adorable husbands a big treat for all their hard work! Sure hope those boys can bury these bones!~-Part three of the collab between myself and Aycee!They absolutely railed this piece with the shading! Hope you guys love it just as much as we do~" - Page 4 & 9

"It's about time our hot boys finally had their cute butts stuffed! They've been such good boys after all. Plus who could say no to that face~Nothing says pride like watching your hot wife relentlessly pound your adorable friends ass!" - Page 5 & 10
n: [Western] [PeppermintHusky & CoffeeSoda] Ben x Ben 69! + Good Boys!
